column2: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE NATIONAL
INNOVATION AGENCY AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-
1.  This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  National  Innovation
Agency Act, No. of 2019, and shall come into operation on
such date as the President may appoint (hereinafter referred
to as “the appointed date”) by Order published in the Gazette.
